channel.title: Latest alerts from Bangladesh Meteorological Department
channel.description: Latest alerts from Bangladesh Meteorological Department

item.title: Maritime Warning - Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Mongla, Payra - 10.09.2026
item.description: A low pressure area has formed over Northwest Bay and adjoining area. Under its influence, squally weather may affect the Maritime Ports, North Bay and adjoining Coastal areas of Bangladesh.
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)

item.title: Heavy Rainfall Warning - Khulna, Barishal, Chattogram, Sylhet - 17.08.2026
item.description: Due to Monsoon Depression over Southwestern part of Bangladesh-West Bengal Coast and adjoining Northwest Bay, heavy (44-88mm/24hours) to very heavy (>88mm/24hours) rainfall is likely to occur at places over Khulna, Barishal, Chattogram and Sylhet divisions during next 48 hours commencing from 08 AM today (17.08.2026)
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)

item.title: Heavy Rainfall Warning - Dhaka, Khulna, Barishal, Chattogram - 06.08.2026
item.description: Due to active Southwest Monsoon, heavy (44-88mm/24hours) to very heavy (>88mm/24hours) rainfall is likely to occur at places over Dhaka, Khulna, Barishal and Chattogram divisions during next 24 hours commencing 09 AM of 06.08.2026. Due to very heavy rainfall, landslide may occur at places over the hilly regions of Chattogram division.
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)

item.title: Warning Message - Low Pressure - Maritime Ports Signal 3 - 26.07.2026
item.description: A Low-Pressure area has formed over northwest Bay and adjoining north Odisha-West Bengal coast. Under its influence, squally weather may affect the maritime ports, North Bay and adjoining coastal areas of Bangladesh. Maritime ports of Chattogram, Cox's Bazar, Mongla and Payra have been advised to hoist local cautionary signal number three (3).
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)

item.title: Landslide Warning - Chattogram Division - 21.07.2026
item.description: Due to the active monsoon, heavy to very heavy rainfall (44-88mm to >88mm/24 hours) is expected over the Chattogram division during the next 48 hours, commencing from 06 AM of 22.07.2026. As a result, landslides may occur at places over the hilly regions of the Chattogram division, including Cox's Bazar, Bandarban, Rangamati and Khagrachari districts.
item.author: swc@bmd.gov.bd (Bangladesh Meteorological Department)
